83:             require(pre.flag_exc == false);

85:             remove pending_reader -= {()};

87:             birds_eye let x: V = pre.storage->0;

102:     transition!{

114:             remove pending_writer -= Some(());
115: 
116:             add writer += Some(());
117: 
118:             birds_eye let x = pre.storage->0;

121:             assert Pred::inv(pre.k, x);

123:     }
124: 
125:     transition!{
126:         release_exc(x: V) {

128:             remove writer -= Some(());

130:             update flag_exc = false;

137:         read_guard(x: V) {

152:     transition!{
153:         release_shared(x: V) {
154:             remove reader -= {x};
155: 
156:             assert(pre.flag_rc >= 1) by {
157:                 assert(equal(pre.storage, Option::Some(x)));

164:     pub fn exc_bit_matches(&self) -> bool {

229: pub trait RwLockPredicate<V>: Sized {
230:     spec fn inv(self, v: V) -> bool;
231: }
232: 
233: impl<V> RwLockPredicate<V> for spec_fn(V) -> bool {
234:     open spec fn inv(self, v: V) -> bool {
235:         self(v)
236:     }
237: }

239: ghost struct InternalPred<V, Pred> {
240:     v: V,
241:     pred: Pred,
242: }
243: 
244: impl<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> InvariantPredicate<Pred, V> for InternalPred<V, Pred> {
245:     closed spec fn inv(k: Pred, v: V) -> bool {
246:         k.inv(v)
247:     }
248: }

250: struct_with_invariants!{
251: 
252:     pub struct RwLock<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
253:         exc: AtomicBool<_, RwLockToks::flag_exc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>, _>,
254:         rc: AtomicUsize<_, RwLockToks::flag_rc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>, _>,
255: 
256:         inst: Tracked<RwLockToks::Instance<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
257:         pred: Ghost<Pred>,
258:     }
259: 
260:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
261:     spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
262:         invariant on exc with (inst) is (v: bool, g: RwLockToks::flag_exc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>) {
263:             g.instance_id() == inst@.id()
264:                 && g.value() == v
265:         }
266: 
267:         invariant on rc with (inst) is (v: usize, g: RwLockToks::flag_rc<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>) {
268:             g.instance_id() == inst@.id()
269:                 && g.value() == v
270:         }
271: 
272:         predicate {
273:             self.inst@.k() == self.pred@
274:         }
275:     }
276: }

278: pub struct WriteHandle<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
279:     tracked handle: Tracked<RwLockToks::writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
280:     rwlock: &'a RwLock<V, Pred>,
281: }

283: pub struct ReadHandle<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> {
284:     tracked handle: Tracked<RwLockToks::reader<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>>,
285:     rwlock: &'a RwLock<V, Pred>,
286: }

288: impl<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> WriteHandle<'a, V, Pred> {
289:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
290:     spec fn wf_write_handle(self) -> bool {
291:         equal(
292:             self.handle@.instance_id(),
293:             self.rwlock.inst@.id(),
294:         ) && self.rwlock.wf()
295:     }
296: 
297:     pub closed spec fn rwlock(self) -> RwLock<V, Pred> {
298:         *self.rwlock
299:     }
300: 
301:     pub fn release_write(self, Tracked(new_val): Tracked<V>)
302:         requires
303:             self.rwlock().inv(new_val),
304:     {
305:         proof {
306:             use_type_invariant(&self);
307:         }
308:         let WriteHandle { handle: Tracked(handle), rwlock } = self;
309: 
310:         atomic_with_ghost!(
311:             &rwlock.exc => store(false);
312:             ghost g =>
313:         {
314:             self.rwlock.inst.borrow().release_exc(new_val, &mut g, new_val, handle);
315:         });
316:     }
317: }

319: impl<'a, V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> ReadHandle<'a, V, Pred> {
320:     #[verifier::type_invariant]
321:     spec fn wf_read_handle(self) -> bool {
322:         equal(self.handle@.instance_id(), self.rwlock.inst@.id())
323:             && self.rwlock.wf()
324:     }
325: 
326:     pub closed spec fn view(self) -> V {
327:         self.handle@.element()
328:     }
329: 
330:     pub closed spec fn rwlock(self) -> RwLock<V, Pred> {
331:         *self.rwlock
332:     }
333: 
334:     pub proof fn borrow<'b>(tracked &'b self) -> (tracked val: &'b V)
335:         ensures
336:             val == self.view(),
337:     {
338:         use_type_invariant(self);
339:         let tracked perm = self.rwlock.inst.borrow().read_guard(
340:             self.handle@.element(),
341:             self.handle.borrow(),
342:         );
343:         &perm
344:     }
345: 
346:     pub proof fn lemma_readers_match(
347:         tracked read_handle1: &ReadHandle<V, Pred>,
348:         tracked read_handle2: &ReadHandle<V, Pred>,
349:     )
350:         requires
351:             read_handle1.rwlock() == read_handle2.rwlock(),
352:         ensures
353:             (equal(read_handle1.view(), read_handle2.view())),
354:     {
355:         use_type_invariant(read_handle1);
356:         use_type_invariant(read_handle2);
357:         read_handle1.rwlock.inst.borrow().read_match(
358:             read_handle1.handle@.element(),
359:             read_handle2.handle@.element(),
360:             &read_handle1.handle.borrow(),
361:             &read_handle2.handle.borrow(),
362:         );
363:     }
364: 
365:     pub fn release_read(self) {
366:         proof { use_type_invariant(&self); }
367:         let ReadHandle { handle: Tracked(handle), rwlock } = self;
368: 
369:         let _ =
370:             atomic_with_ghost!(
371:             &rwlock.rc => fetch_sub(1);
372:             ghost g =>
373:         {
374:             rwlock.inst.borrow().release_shared(handle.element(), &mut g, handle);
375:         });
376:     }
377: }

379: impl<V, Pred: RwLockPredicate<V>> RwLock<V, Pred> {
380:     pub closed spec fn pred(&self) -> Pred {
381:         self.pred@
382:     }
383: 
384:     pub open spec fn inv(&self, val: V) -> bool {
385:         self.pred().inv(val)
386:     }
387: 
388:     pub fn new(Tracked(val): Tracked<V>, Ghost(pred): Ghost<Pred>) -> (s: Self)
389:         requires
390:             pred.inv(val),
391:         ensures
392:             s.pred() == pred,
393:     {
394:         let tracked (Tracked(inst), Tracked(flag_exc), Tracked(flag_rc), _, _, _, _) =
395:             RwLockToks::Instance::<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>::initialize_full(pred, val, Some(val));
396:         let inst = Tracked(inst);
397: 
398:         let exc = AtomicBool::new(Ghost(inst), false, Tracked(flag_exc));
399:         let rc = AtomicUsize::new(Ghost(inst), 0, Tracked(flag_rc));
400: 
401:         RwLock { exc, rc, inst, pred: Ghost(pred) }
402:     }

404:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
405:     pub fn acquire_write(&self) -> (ret: (Tracked<V>, WriteHandle<'_, V, Pred>))
406:         ensures
407:             ({
408:                 let val = *ret.0;
409:                 let write_handle = ret.1;
410:                 &&& write_handle.rwlock() == *self
411:                 &&& self.inv(val)
412:             }),
413:     {
414:         proof {
415:             use_type_invariant(self);
416:         }
417:         let mut done = false;
418:         let tracked mut token: Option<
419:             RwLockToks::pending_writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
420:         > = Option::None;
421:         while !done
422:             invariant
423:                 done ==> token.is_some() && equal(token->0.instance_id(), self.inst@.id()),
424:                 self.wf(),
425:         {
426:             let result =
427:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
428:                 &self.exc => compare_exchange(false, true);
429:                 returning res;
430:                 ghost g =>
431:             {
432:                 if res is Ok {
433:                     token = Option::Some(self.inst.borrow().acquire_exc_start(&mut g));
434:                 }
435:             });
436: 
437:             done =
438:             match result {
439:                 Result::Ok(_) => true,
440:                 _ => false,
441:             };
442:         }
443:         loop
444:             invariant
445:                 token is Some && equal(token->0.instance_id(), self.inst@.id()),
446:                 self.wf(),
447:         {
448:             let tracked mut perm_opt: Option<V> = None;
449:             let tracked mut handle_opt: Option<
450:                 RwLockToks::writer<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
451:             > = None;
452: 
453:             let result =
454:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
455:                 &self.rc => load();
456:                 returning res;
457:                 ghost g =>
458:             {
459:                 if res == 0 {
460:                     let tracked tok = match token { Option::Some(t) => t, Option::None => proof_from_false() };
461:                     let tracked x = self.inst.borrow().acquire_exc_end(&g, tok);
462:                     token = None;
463:                     let tracked (_, Tracked(perm), Tracked(exc_handle)) = x;
464:                     perm_opt = Some(perm);
465:                     handle_opt = Some(exc_handle);
466:                 }
467:             });
468: 
469:             if result == 0 {
470:                 let tracked mut perm = match perm_opt {
471:                     Option::Some(t) => t,
472:                     Option::None => proof_from_false(),
473:                 };
474:                 let tracked handle = match handle_opt {
475:                     Option::Some(t) => t,
476:                     Option::None => proof_from_false(),
477:                 };
478:                 let write_handle = WriteHandle {
479:                     handle: Tracked(handle),
480:                     rwlock: self,
481:                 };
482:                 return (Tracked(perm), write_handle);
483:             }
484:         }
485:     }

487:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
488:     pub fn acquire_read(&self) -> (read_handle: ReadHandle<'_, V, Pred>)
489:         ensures
490:             read_handle.rwlock() == *self,
491:             self.inv(read_handle.view()),
492:     {
493:         proof {
494:             use_type_invariant(self);
495:         }
496:         loop
497:             invariant
498:                 self.wf(),
499:         {
500:             let val = atomic_with_ghost!(&self.rc => load(); ghost g => { });
501: 
502:             let tracked mut token: Option<
503:                 RwLockToks::pending_reader<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>,
504:             > = Option::None;
505: 
506:             if val < usize::MAX {
507:                 let result =
508:                     atomic_with_ghost!(
509:                     &self.rc => compare_exchange(val, val + 1);
510:                     returning res;
511:                     ghost g =>
512:                 {
513:                     if res is Ok {
514:                         token = Option::Some(self.inst.borrow().acquire_read_start(&mut g));
515:                     }
516:                 });
517: 
518:                 match result {
519:                     Result::Ok(_) => {
520:                         let tracked mut handle_opt:
521:                             Option<RwLockToks::reader<Pred, V, InternalPred<V, Pred>>> = None;
522: 
523:                         let result =
524:                             atomic_with_ghost!(
525:                             &self.exc => load();
526:                             returning res;
527:                             ghost g =>
528:                         {
529:                             if res == false {
530:                                 let tracked tok = match token { Option::Some(t) => t, Option::None => proof_from_false() };
531:                                 let tracked x = self.inst.borrow().acquire_read_end(&g, tok);
532:                                 token = None;
533:                                 let tracked (_, Tracked(exc_handle)) = x;
534:                                 handle_opt = Some(exc_handle);
535:                             }
536:                         });
537: 
538:                         if result == false {
539:                             let tracked handle = match handle_opt {
540:                                 Option::Some(t) => t,
541:                                 Option::None => proof_from_false(),
542:                             };
543:                             let read_handle = ReadHandle { handle: Tracked(handle), rwlock: self };

555:                     },
556:                     _ => {},
557:                 }
558:             }
559:         }
560:     }

654:             have frag >= [key => let opt_val];
